data.name: Saarvik
data.long_meaning: Saarvik is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Saarva', which means 'all' or 'whole'. The suffix 'ik' denotes 'lord' or 'ruler'. Saarvik is thus the lord or ruler of the entire sky. In Hindu mythology, Saarvik is the name of the god Indra, the deity of the sky and rain.
